theorems.name: Submission.cmr_cc_det_covector_basis_kronecker
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (I J : Fin n → Fin P) (θ : Covector (Euclid P) n), StrictMono I → StrictMono J → (∀ v : Fin n → Euclid P, θ v = Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun k j => v j (I k))) → θ (fun j => EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin P) ℝ (J j)) = if I = J then 1 else 0
